bolometric_flux_fractional_difference.source: One-percent energy-flux agreement is required before comparing spectral shape.

ionizing_photon_rate_log10_difference_de.source: A 0.1 dex ionizing-seed tolerance is adopted before later line formation.

maximum_diagnostic_band_flux_fractional_.source: Ten-percent change in any fixed observer diagnostic band blocks the small-difference route.

normalized_shape_l1_distance.source: Ten-percent normalized spectral-shape distance defines the small-difference route.

nu_fnu_peak_energy_log10_difference_dex.source: A peak-energy ratio within 1/1.25 to 1.25 defines a small shift.

maximum_history_hysteresis_l1.source: A ten-percent normalized loop mismatch is the preregistered single-valued-closure test.

maximum_thermal_time_over_orbital_period.source: A decade of timescale separation is adopted as the static-response gate; this is not a literature theorem.

physical_static_root_fraction.source: Complete source-domain coverage is required; one failed physical column rejects a single-valued static closure.
